shots.title: Bump @slope-dev/slope and bundled Codex plugin to v1.57.0
shots.notes: Added S123 and Phase 38 to the roadmap, then used scripts/version-bump.mjs to move package.json and the bundled Codex plugin manifest from 1.56.2 to 1.57.0.

shots.title: Run release validation, publish v1.57.0, and verify npm

hazards.description: The local post-push guard reported no active sprint after pushes even though node dist/cli/index.js sprint status showed S123 active; release work continued after re-running briefing/status.

shots.notes: Merged PR #454, published GitHub release v1.57.0, watched the trusted-publisher npm workflow pass, verified npm latest is 1.57.0, and smoke-tested the installed package.

training.description: Release scorecards should wait for registry verification before claiming publish success.
training.outcome: S123 recorded release completion only after npm latest returned 1.57.0 and an installed-package slope version smoke test passed.

training.description: Minor release sprints should stay scoped to the already-merged fix.
training.outcome: Newly open issues #452 and #453 were noted for the next implementation sprint instead of being mixed into the v1.57.0 release train.

training.description: Keep build and test sequential when tests execute generated dist output.
training.outcome: The release validation ran pnpm build, pnpm typecheck, and pnpm test sequentially, avoiding the S121 dist rewrite race.

nutrition.description: Build, typecheck, full pnpm test, SLOPE validation, roadmap validation, map check, whitespace check, PR CI, and release workflow tests passed.
GitHub release v1.57.0 and npm trusted publishing completed successfully; npm latest now resolves to 1.57.0.
Open issues #452 and #453 remain queued after the release.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: Smooth and deliberately narrow: the release train did exactly one thing and the trusted-publisher path stayed clean.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: Treat fresh GitHub issues as next-sprint work during a release sprint unless they block the publish itself.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: The only wrinkle was the post-push active-sprint warning, which matched the kind of roadmap/workflow drift already showing up in the new issue batch.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: The Codex worktree hook cwd fix is now available from npm, and the next sprint has two concrete agent-DX issues ready to triage.

bunker_locations: Release scorecards should wait for registry verification before claiming publish success.
Trusted publishing still needs an npm metadata check and installed-package smoke test after the GitHub workflow passes.
Post-push sprint-state warnings should be investigated separately from release flow when they do not block the publish.
yardage_book_updates: Version bump path remains node scripts/version-bump.mjs <version>, updating package.json and templates/codex/plugins/slope/.codex-plugin/plugin.json together.
The v1.57.0 release path uses GitHub release publishing with npm trusted publisher OIDC.
npm exec --yes --package @slope-dev/slope@<version> -- slope version remains the installed-package smoke test.
Keep pnpm build, pnpm typecheck, and pnpm test sequential during release validation because CLI tests can load generated dist output.
